method: Manual independent reasoning from shuffled exact proposition/title/URL/excerpt packet and rubric only. Body content determines basis; identifying metadata cannot add omitted facts.
stanceDiagnosticMeaning: Textual relation to the proposition, separate from content qualification or final factual verdict. Supports on a non-substantive unit records only its unsupported or attributed assertion; unclear means insufficient operative relation.

annotations.supportingSpan: Bumblebees retrieve only the ordinal ranking
annotations.labelReason: Only the paper title is retained. It does not retain the described experiments, sucrose training, novel pairings or measured comparison needed for this proposition.

annotations.supportingSpan: SEC. 2. JUNETEENTH NATIONAL INDEPENDENCE DAY AS A LEGAL PUBLIC HOLIDAY.
annotations.labelReason: This is a section heading without the operative amendment or June19 date. A heading cannot supply the omitted legal contents.

annotations.supportingSpan: "objectDate":"1889"
annotations.labelReason: Actual catalogue fields bind the work title, named artist and object date. This is an identifiable record entry supporting the stated catalogue date; the metadata publisher alone is not the basis.

annotations.supportingSpan: Juneteenth National Independence Day, June 19.
annotations.labelReason: The retained law identifies the enactment and actually inserts the holiday/date into the statutory list. Its operative June19 value contradicts June20 while preserving substantive content basis.

annotations.supportingSpan: Legal commentators agree
annotations.labelReason: The claimed social outcome is supported only by unnamed commentators and success language. No evaluation, observations, comparison or identifiable empirical result is retained; the statute title cannot establish a reduction in illegal hunting.

annotations.supportingSpan: Neither of these treatments reduced the number of nest mates
annotations.labelReason: The body retains the coil intervention, field treatments, measured recruitment outcome and station location. These actual methods/findings contradict the claim that both treatments reduced recruitment.

annotations.supportingSpan: This section has no associated Explanatory Notes
annotations.labelReason: The section heading and explanatory-note notice do not retain an offence rule or its exception. No operative legal content may be inferred from the URL or title.

annotations.labelReason: Unnamed expert consensus and art-guide promotion do not retain the Met catalogue entry or another identifiable evidentiary basis. Agreement on a date is not proof of what the specified catalogue records.

annotations.supportingSpan: The Nickel Boys , by Colson Whitehead (Doubleday)
annotations.labelReason: The actual2020 Fiction winner record supplies The Nickel Boys, rather than the claimed The Underground Railroad. An incompatible winning value does not remove the substantive award-record basis.

annotations.supportingSpan: higher ranking over higher absolute reward
annotations.labelReason: The retained experiments explicitly report ordinal ranking preferred over higher absolute reward in novel pairings, the reverse of the claim. Training, comparisons and further tests identify an actual research basis.

annotations.supportingSpan: A person commits an offence if he hunts a wild mammal with a dog, unless his hunting is exempt.
annotations.labelReason: The operative legal sentence identifies the regulated act, offence and exemption. This short complete rule is substantive content, unlike a heading alone.

annotations.supportingSpan: A reading-club host says
annotations.labelReason: The retained award assertion is merely a club host quotation surrounded by promotion. It can evidence what the host said, but the checked proposition is the actual award outcome, not that speech act.

annotations.supportingSpan: A person commits an offence if he hunts a wild mammal with a dog, unless his hunting is exempt.
annotations.labelReason: The operative offence rule and exemption directly contradict the claim of no offence when not exempt. The same retained statute is substantive for either polarity.

limitations: Supported/refuted pairs reuse the same passages and are not independent source observations.
No source truth/authenticity, provenance independence, risk, probability threshold or final verdict sufficiency was evaluated.
Headings and citations identify subjects but cannot supply missing operative contents, field values or methods/findings.
Promotional framing does not automatically negate a retained actual record; these negative promotional units lack a demonstrated basis for their checked relation.
